title: EVALUATING LLMS FOR GENDER DISPARITIES IN NOTABLE PERSONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating factuality metrics (recall, miss rate, hallucinations, and declinations) in LLM responses to prompts about notable persons (entrepreneurs, actors, and Nobel Prize winners) across male and female genders. The study measures disparities using Demographic Parity Difference (DPD) and a novel Response Concentration Score (RCS) to analyze gender representation in hallucinated names. It also examines how gender-associated words in prompts (calculated via GloVe embeddings) correlate with the gender of hallucinated outputs.
